svg.title: 01_Database_Schema
svg.text: SPENDLY PERSONAL FINANCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM - DATABASE SCHEMA
PK = primary key FK = foreign key UQ = unique ? = nullable
Identifiers: VARCHAR(36) Money: NUMERIC(14,2) Timestamps: UTC
One run has 0..1 forecast; its analysis_run_id is unique.
Delete rules: CASCADE, except alert transaction references use SET NULL.
Only declared foreign keys are drawn. Admin audit targets and model-version labels are not foreign keys.
